summary: The PR simplifies the code by using subprocess.run and setting PGPASSWORD in the environment, which is a good improvement. However, there are some minor issues related to error handling and documentation.

issues.description: The previous code handled UnicodeEncodeError by letting the user input the password manually. The new code does not handle this case, which might be a regression risk.
The PR does not include any comments explaining why the old method was replaced or how the new method handles different scenarios, such as UnicodeEncodeError.
